early_selection: Reuse each line's exact original v37 early heldout issue, sequence, state and memory. Require old first transition and exact300 cost to replay exactly; no reselection.
late_selection: First native issue per line in this fixed half-open window with both executed F candidates supported, actual isAtBusStop true, and action gap >=1.5*max(simulation step, actionStepLength). Check before forking, never select on future outcomes. Missing or physical aliases stay declared.
native_controller: Original frozen50000 zero-memory initializer with unchanged F and real clocks, as in v37. Fork only selected executed action; both suffixes share native state and exogenous seed and run concurrently. v37r1 models only score the recorded chain afterward.
model_preflight: Load all three resident final50456-update,285-label v37r1 models before native work; exactly reproduce all existing four issue predictions including variants, components and CRN. No checkpoint downloaded, no update rerun.
endpoint_contract: Record every true global transition and causal memory plus each native passenger tick. Keep exact issue+300 ledger separate. Close pending row only at first real nonterminal control event at/after300, without issuing that endpoint action. If none by420, retain missing endpoint and unlabelled partial ledger, never fabricate ns, terminal or s300.
analysis_contract: Match events by line,vehicle,trip,station and occurrence, reporting asynchronous clocks. Use common-random-number frozen Bellman probes. Keep fixed300 W/R/C contrasts distinct from accumulated true-event rewards and bootstrap at each real endpoint. Zero-duration transitions and missing/unsupported states are explicit.

native_bellman.interpretation: The diagnostic return uses the recorded common continuation and is not the original mixed Bellman operator iterated on-policy. It does not replace long-horizon Q with finite300 cost.
native_bellman.accounting_identity: q0=sum(r_scaled)+b_last+sum(b_i-q_(i+1))-sum(target_i-q_i)+sum(target_i-r_scaled_i-b_i). Split continuation gap into mixed-versus-recorded-target-Q and target lag.

feedback: All v38 truth is diagnostic only, never admitted to replay. Native prefixes and suffixes and frozen scoring have zero optimizer/world/trust updates. No old diagnostic truth is added to training.

compute_budget.preflight: First actual paired diagnostic is reused in the full run; old predictions are read-only. Report actual overrun, missing endpoints and any failed-prefix or suffix overhead separately.

decision_gate: After exact old-model/native replay, full declared coverage, actual parallelism and zero-training checks, identify when physical W/R/C separation enters genuine rewards and bootstrap. Limit the next proposal to one target change supported by that timing and operator-gap evidence; do not automatically start training or independent confirmation.
